svg.title: The newborn needing extra care, sorted by what it must be kept: pink (resuscitation at birth, then respiratory distress told apart by who, timing and chest x-ray), warm (hypothermia), sweet (hypoglycemia screening and treatment), free of sepsis (risk, workup, antibiotics) and the yellow baby (jaundice red flags, investigations, phototherapy); each column gives presentation, numbered assessment and treatment, with a panel on routine care before discharge
